findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_rental_status" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Same data as rental_status (which takes the access code instead): rental state, start and end times, and delivered TH reported by the rigs. awaitingPoolApproval…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_vendors" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the human-verified directory of merchants that accept native Bitcoin (on-chain + Lightning) for real goods. Each listing carries its verification date and a `stale` flag against a 90-day re-verification window; the response reports how many matches are stale. Filter by free-text query, catego" → after: "Search the human-verified directory of merchants that accept native Bitcoin (on-chain + Lightning) for everyday goods. Each listing carries its verification date, is monitored automatically every day, and is flagged `stale` only if no human has confirmed it in 180 days; the response reports how many"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
